title: IF...ELSE Statement
description: Learn how to use IF...ELSE for conditional control flow in T-SQL.

data.text: The IF...ELSE statement is a control-flow statement that allows you to execute or skip a statement block based on a specified condition.

data.title: IF...ELSE syntax
data.content: Executes different blocks based on a condition.
data.code:
IF Boolean_expression
BEGIN
    -- Statement block executes when TRUE
END
ELSE
BEGIN
    -- Statement block executes when FALSE
END

data.title: Check sales amount with IF...ELSE
data.content: Checks if sales exceeded a threshold and prints a message.

data.title: IF...ELSE Key Points
points: IF evaluates a Boolean expression and executes the THEN block if TRUE.
ELSE provides an alternative block for when the expression is FALSE.
Avoid deeply nested IF statements for readability.
IF...ELSE is commonly used in stored procedures and triggers.
